findings.title: OS Command Injection

findings.assumptions: The code does not sanitize or validate input before using it in a command execution context. The attacker could potentially inject shell commands into the input.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: Attacker inputs more than 257 characters (the size of buffer - 1 for null terminator)
findings.assumptions: The buffer is fixed-size and does not dynamically adjust based on input size. The attacker could potentially overflow the buffer.
